newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton output reaches 6.316 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton output reaches 6.316 mln bales.

text.p: The state-run Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan said on Saturday cotton output in 1996/97 (July-June) crop year had reached a provisional 6.316 million 170-kg bales by December 12, down from 6.416 million bales by the same date last year.
It said mills had bought 4.552 million bales, down from 4.337 million in the year-ago period, while exporters had purchased only 2,000 bales against 486,700 last year.
Ginning factories had unsold stocks of 1.761 million bales, compared to 1.592 million bales in the year-ago period.
Officials now estimate the 1996/97 crop at slightly above nine million bales, well below the official target of 10 million bales and last year's output of 9.96 million.
This year's harvest has suffered from pest damage, mainly in Punjab province, Pakistan's main cotton belt.
